baseline.observedDefect: A semantic PLACE camera and awareness selection could move to Dallas while GRIDLY_ACTIVE_COUNTY_ID and its Liberty inventory remained unchanged.

rootCause.condition: PLACE and canonical multi-county PLACE branches committed presentation state without invoking gridlySetActiveCountyContext; startup canonical PLACE restoration likewise bypassed the transition owner.

runtimeOwnerBefore: gridlySetActiveCountyContext owned reload behavior, but not every authoritative semantic-location path called it.
runtimeOwnerAfter: gridlySynchronizeActiveCountyForOperationalContext resolves governed identity and delegates changed counties exactly once to gridlySetActiveCountyContext.
canonicalCountyIdentitySource: Explicit governed county ID/FIPS where present; otherwise the established gridlyResolveLocationContext statewide coordinate containment result. Multi-county membership order is never used.
transitionLifecycle: generation increment and stale inventory clear

asyncProtection.mechanism: county ID plus monotonic transition generation checked before commit

cacheBehavior.positiveToEmpty: old inventory cleared; zero-length inventory is treated as loaded
cacheBehavior.sameCounty: no transition, generation increment, or reload

tests.relatedHistoricalStaticAssertions: 2 pre-existing string-shape assertions fail against current implementation and are not LP202.2 behavioral regressions

deferredFindings: Legacy profile/home-town fields can remain intentionally distinct from operational county authority.
Two historical county-runtime tests assert obsolete source strings and should be rebaselined separately without weakening behavioral coverage.

multiCountyPlaceOperationalResolution.rootCause: gridlyDispatchSemanticCamera invoked active-county synchronization before it resolved the governed PLACE presentation target. The operational resolver only inspected coordinates already attached to the awareness-area object; LP196 canonical multi-county areas intentionally have countyId null and carry no lat/lng, so Dallas failed closed before the same function later looked up its governed camera.
multiCountyPlaceOperationalResolution.resolutionMode: canonical PLACE GEOID -> governed consumer override or statewide presentation target -> gridlyResolveCountyIdForCoordinate authoritative containment -> governed membership validation -> canonical Gridly county ID -> existing synchronization owner
multiCountyPlaceOperationalResolution.startupResult: PASS: unresolved startup PLACE contexts wait for the governed presentation artifact and then run the same synchronizer; Liberty inventory is cleared before Dallas package commit.
multiCountyPlaceOperationalResolution.manualSelectionResult: PASS: semantic dispatch resolves the governed camera and synchronizes Dallas without refresh or viewport dependence.

liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.exactBlockedHandoff: gridlyDispatchSemanticCamera called the synchronizer while the runtime county geometry package was not ready. Coordinate containment returned coordinate_county_unresolved, the synchronizer failed closed, and the successful semantic camera return prevented the manual caller presentation retry. A later diagnostic resolver call succeeded after geometry readiness, but diagnostics do not invoke the transition owner.
liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.rootCause: The synchronizer had no geometry-readiness retry. Its !resolvedCountyId guard returned null before gridlySetActiveCountyContext, even though the same canonical PLACE resolved later. It was synchronous (not an unawaited synchronizer), did not compare nullable awareness countyId, had no startup mutation guard, did not shadow active state, and the setter accepts governed statewide IDs.
liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.productionCallerRepaired: gridlySynchronizeActiveCountyForOperationalContext now requests the de-duplicated authoritative geometry load and re-enters itself on readiness; gridlyDispatchSemanticCamera remains the real semantic caller and gridlySetActiveCountyContext remains the sole transition owner.
liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.startupResult: PASS: startup synchronization retries authoritative containment readiness and commits through the setter without user interaction.
liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.manualSelectionResult: PASS: the real semantic-camera caller retries containment readiness and commits Dallas without refresh.
liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.rapidTransitionResult: PASS: existing county plus monotonic-generation checks suppress stale Liberty and Dallas commits after Tarrant becomes active.
liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.activeEmptyResult: PASS: positive to ACTIVE_EMPTY clears and intentionally commits zero; empty to positive reloads governed inventory.
liveActiveCountyCommitRepair.sameCountyResult: PASS: resolved active county bypasses the setter, generation increment, clear, and reload.

tests.lp2022: PASS (9/9, including production semantic caller -> synchronizer readiness retry -> real setter -> shared runtime state)
